newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues additional fuel oil tender for March.
newsitem.headline: India issues additional fuel oil tender for March.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy three more cargoes of high sulphur fuel oil for delivery in March to Bombay, a company official said on Wednesday.
In its latest tender, IOC is seeking to buy three 30,000-tonne 180-cst, 3.5 percent sulphur grade fuel oil cargoes for delivery March 8-12, 16-20 and 26-31 respectively, the official said.
The tender closes on February 27 and offers are valid for one day.
IOC had earlier issued a tender to buy one cargo of the same grade for delivery March 1-5 to Bombay. The tender closes February 20 and is valid for one day.
India last purchased two cargoes for February at between $10.48 to $10.80 per tonne over Mideast quotes on a cost-and-freight basis.
